question: KGNI is related to LHOJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GCJE is related to HDKF. To which of the following is OKRM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58a64827e7fdaf2db33f5a6a533a215b6b6d3071ccf3db4b92320573b25ddc0b.png] 

The logic followed here is:

KGNI is related to LHOJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48789277a38bf42d36c1c8a182717c10bc6bd75129c6398aa1dabdb79b2b9c59.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ad7dc0cf36a935dba21defa356d2983765336c1256d2ae3c83962a2e4cf9b9e.png] 

GCJE is related to HDKF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6bee1b4e508e95982e0c02bec4a5cea51bdf59ea7bb43d5e010da56cb4bf637.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/484cb90d58c0d266630d18385ecef99322740259fef9efd963eaba197cba1c74.png] 

Similarly,

OKRM is related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e57c67fce54c6111240cf26c80181599d4802e440c33634408fc8b94204c9b0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/625ab5b8ca03102a32d3f75d4dd33b466fb25c989cd2a173ef4a2699abe3c9a1.png] 

Thus, OKRM is related to 'PLSN'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
